Corporate Leaders Discuss the Future of India’s Economy at TIME Impact Dinner

Corporate leaders in India spoke about the country’s economic growth and potential in the coming years at TIME’s The Partnership Imperative: Building the Next Chapter of Growth dinner in Andhra Pradesh on Thursday.
